paraphrase: In the stipulated descriptive/permission-plan semantics, ideal acceptance preserves modus ponens for all formulas and states; a nonempty state with an eligible action accepts distinct forbidden-action atoms p and q and their conditional, and another nonempty state with an eligible action accepts q and if p then q but not p. This is an analyst semantic control, not an attribution to Blackburn/Gibbard or a resolution of historical expressivism.
